item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)
Issued at 11:00 AM 15 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are expected over #CamarinesSur(Libmanan, Cabusao, Tinambac, Lagonoy, Calabanga, Bombon, Magarao, Garchitorena, Goa), #Sorsogon(Bulusan, SantaMagdalena, Irosin, Matnog, Bulan, Juban, Casiguran, Magallanes, CityOfSorsogon), #NorthernSamar(Rosario, SanJose, SanAntonio, Capul, Lavezares, Allen) and #Masbate(Balud) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesNorte, #CamarinesSur(Sipocot, Lupi, DelGallego, Ragay, Siruma), #Sorsogon(Barcelona, Gubat, PrietoDiaz) and #NorthernSamar(Biri) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 02:00 PM Today.
